newsitem.title: CHINA: Huangshan to list A shares next Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Huangshan to list A shares next Tuesday.

text.p: Huangshan Tourism Development Co Ltd 600054.SS will list 37.5 million domestic A shares on the Shanghai stock exchange next Tuesday, a company statement said on Wednesday.

The A shares, together with 2.5 million staff shares, were issued earlier this month at 6.02 yuan per share, raising a net of 230.8 million yuan with proceeds being used to improve tourist facilities in the Huangshan area, one of China's famous scenic spots.

The firm, which listed foreign currency B shares in Shanghai in November last year, posted a 1996 net profit of 60.78 million yuan against 1995's 41.73 million yuan based on international accounting standards, the statement said.
Under Chinese accounting standards, the 1996 net was 64.01 million yuan against 43.31 million the year before, it said.
The firm did not give a prediction for 1997 results.

The firm now has a total 233 million outstanding shares, comprising 113 million state shares, 80 million B shares, 37.5 million A shares and 2.5 million employee shares, which will be listed as A shares six months after the issue in line with China's securities rules, the statement said.
